desktop:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: 4DTraveler present-day Rome desktop bird's-eye overview endpoint
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and locked camera/composition.
Primary request: Correct the central urban geography so this reads unmistakably as modern Rome, not an intact ancient city. Rebuild the middle of the frame around the actual present-day monumental axis. Add the large, bright white marble Vittoriano / Altare della Patria at Piazza Venezia near the western end of the Imperial Fora, between the Pantheon and Forum area. Add the broad straight Via dei Fori Imperiali, lined by umbrella pines, running clearly from Piazza Venezia/Vittoriano through the excavated forum zone toward the Colosseum. The Roman and Imperial Fora must be open archaeological excavations with fragmented foundations, surviving columns, paths and exposed earth—not intact roofed temples or a continuous ancient neighborhood. The Colosseum must remain a partially ruined elliptical shell with its broken outer wall and visible hypogeum. Circus Maximus must remain a long green archaeological park without ancient seating. Palatine must be a green archaeological hill with ruins. Surrounding neighborhoods must be dense modern central-Rome blocks: multi-story ochre/cream stucco palazzi, realistic streets, occasional church domes, modern river embankments and tiny contemporary cars.
Style/medium: highly detailed photorealistic aerial architectural visualization, natural materials and believable present-day urban scale, warm clear afternoon light.
Composition/framing: preserve Image 1's exact 1586:992 landscape aspect ratio, camera angle, projection, crop, skyline extent, Tiber course, and registered landmark centers. Pantheon remains near (0.12,0.51), Colosseum near (0.855,0.38), Trajan/Forum precinct near (0.43,0.37), Palatine near (0.60,0.64), Circus Maximus at lower right, Tiber at lower left. Make the new Vittoriano prominent near the Forum/Piazza Venezia terminus without covering the Pantheon.
Constraints: change the inaccurate urban fabric and archaeological condition while keeping the endpoint framing and anchors locked. No text, labels, watermark, extra rivers, fantasy architecture, intact ancient city blocks, reconstructed forum roofs, intact Circus seating, or second Colosseum.
